source: Mercado Libre Developers documentation reviewed locally and via official pages on 2026-07-25
purpose: Compact operational contract for ERP Meli API anti-blocking guardrails. No tokens, credentials, customer data, orders, raw production JSON, or secrets are included.

global_policy.bulk_web_requests: discouraged; must use queue when estimate exceeds safe web budget
global_policy.retry_after: must be respected before retrying any affected account/endpoint/job type
global_policy.unknown_endpoint: blocked unless registered in MeliEndpointRegistry and documented in generated/endpoints.json

documented_blocking_signals.action: open global circuit, pause Mercado Libre jobs, show critical admin alert
open global circuit and require admin review of app scopes/permissions
open global circuit and stop all non-OAuth Mercado Libre jobs
respect Retry-After, set cooldown, do not retry massively
classify permission vs critical block, open circuit for repeated failures
open preventive circuit after repeated invalid requests; review parameters before retrying
attempt controlled refresh only when appropriate; invalid_grant marks account token invalid without massive retries

/payments/{id}.reason: ERP uses orders[].payments[] as default source; direct payment detail remains disabled to avoid unreliable/legacy 404 flows.

/items/{id}/description.limits: persistent queue with adaptive pause; never from public catalog

/user-products/{id}/stock.on_403: mark permission_required or unsupported; do not convert unknown stock into zero

/billing/integration/group/ML/order/deta.limits: maximum 60 order IDs per request; ambiguous lines must not be used for definitive net

module_recommendations.orders: Use /orders/search and confirmed order/shipment/pack endpoints with idempotent chunks.
module_recommendations.products: Use offset/limit for small accounts and scan/scroll_id for large accounts; never mix scroll_id with offset in the same scan request.
module_recommendations.sales_audit: Keep quick limit=1 checks in web; queue exact long audits when range exceeds configured threshold.
module_recommendations.catalog: Use snapshots only; never instantiate MeliApiClient from public catalog controllers or views.
module_recommendations.descriptions: Use persistent catalog description jobs with checkpoints, 20-item batches and adaptive pauses.
module_recommendations.stock_origin: Treat unsupported or permission-required responses as unknown/unavailable, not as zero stock.
module_recommendations.billing: Use trusted classified billing lines for reconciled net; unknown lines force revision_manual.
module_recommendations.claims_questions: Read-only; pause safely if documented parameters are rejected by Mercado Libre.
